title: Appeal.
bodyText: Any party aggrieved by an order or decree of the court may appeal as provided by section 571-54.
bodyHtml: [§346-243]  Appeal.  Any party aggrieved by an order or decree of the court may appeal as provided by section 571-54. [L 1989, c 381, pt of §1; am L 1990, c 144, §1 and c 234, §9]
